$description: Canonical ailocal artifact tokens. HAND-AUTHORED — this file is the mapping, not the palette. Every colour is an alias into themes/carbon.tokens.json, which is generated from a pinned @carbon/themes release. Renderers read the resolved result through tokens.py and never learn that a value came from blue.60.

ownership: MODEL OWNS: semantic content, relationships, labels, requested format.
DESIGN SYSTEM OWNS: colour, typeface, hierarchy, spacing, presentation defaults.
Carbon owns the colour VALUES. ailocal owns which semantic role each one serves,
and owns typography, geometry, edge dash patterns and type labels outright —
Carbon is a UI system and has no opinion about diagram edges.
Accent step policy: light diagram accents take Carbon step 60, dark step 40.
Carbon tunes each family so a given step lands at the same contrast, so this
one rule gives every diagram kind [REAL] >= 4.5:1 on light and >= 6.1:1 on dark
against both canvas and surface. It also makes the accents near-identical in
LUMINANCE, which is precisely why the printed type label below is load-bearing
and colour is never the sole carrier of meaning (C4 notation rule).

sans.$description: UI/label face. Deliberately the platform stack: an artifact must render with no network.

type_label.$description: The printed kind label that carries meaning colour must not carry alone.

accent_rail_px.$description: The type rail. A graphical object required for understanding, so it is contrast-gated.

light.$description: Light theme. Surfaces and text alias Carbon g10; accents alias palette step 60.

faint.$description: Least prominent text still gated >= 4.5:1 — Carbon's helper role, not a decorative grey.

border.$description: Decorative reinforcement of a boundary already carried by fill, rail and text. Deliberately NOT contrast-gated.

dark.$description: Dark theme. Surfaces and text alias Carbon g100; accents alias palette step 40.

edge_kinds.$description: ailocal-owned. Each relationship kind pairs an accent with a dash pattern AND a text label, so an edge stays identifiable in greyscale.

type_labels.$description: ailocal-owned. C4 notation: every element states its TYPE in text.
